description: Looks one http or https URL up in the PhishTank phishing database (live checkurl lookup, no key). Returns whether PhishTank has the URL and, if so, its phish id, verification flag and validity. Absence means PhishTank has no record of this exact URL, not that it is safe. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
